thread:
maya: Drafted microcopy for the 'are you sure' modal when removing a dedicated pool — quick eyes for tone + a11y? Here's the current draft:

maya: ```
Header: Remove dedicated pool
Body: Removing a pool will stop all running jobs and cannot be undone. Do you want to continue?
Primary CTA: Remove pool
Secondary CTA: Cancel
```

jonathan: 'cannot be undone' reads a bit blunt. Could we say 'This action is permanent' or 'This can't be undone'? I slightly prefer "can't be undone" for plain language.

sam: Also: what happens to logs/metrics? We should call out retention/deletion or avoid promising a window.

lisa: We shouldn't assert specific retention periods without legal sign-off. Maybe 'Associated logs and metrics may be deleted' is safer.

maya: Good call. Also thinking about CTA wording — 'Remove pool' is short but maybe ambiguous. Should primary CTA include 'permanently'? e.g., 'Permanently remove pool'?

jonathan: Avoid parentheses. "Permanently remove pool" as the primary CTA reads clearer. Secondary stays 'Cancel'.

sam: Dev note: default keyboard focus should land on Cancel to prevent accidental destructive clicks. Also add a tiny helper line: 'Press Esc to close'.

maya: Updated draft below — please react or suggest tiny edits.

maya: ```
Header: Permanently remove pool
Body: Permanently remove this dedicated pool. This will stop all running jobs and may delete associated logs and metrics. This action cannot be undone.
Primary CTA: Permanently remove pool
Secondary CTA: Cancel
Helper text (small): Press Esc to cancel
```

lisa: +1 on tone, but I'll loop Legal on the 'may delete' phrasing.

jonathan: :thumbsup: Nice. Tiny nit: 'Press Esc to cancel' is fine; double-check localized keyboards in i18n notes.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: changing modal copy will enqueue translation/i18n jobs.

maya: Thanks — I'll add i18n keys and open a follow-up PR. Leaving this thread open for legal input, otherwise moving to final copy.
